# Acquisition-only certification of an accepted quantum operation
2026-10-29. New protocol and all-input proof, awaiting independent review. No separate matching-validation role is used. This is NOT postselection of an older accepted-error guarantee.

## 0. Mission and actual boundary
Use the finite fixed-clock FTPL acquisition controller, its actual product-probe records, a service with the CP/memory interface below and a verified outer quantum code correcting arbitrary errors on at most t of J native logical service slots. At the fixed-four-spin port each service carries one bare logical qubit through the paid four-spin encoder, current frame, complete source call, inverse controls and total decoder. It may use physical-permutation orbit randomization, but the cheaper bare-logical-Pauli version proved in section6 is sufficient and is the preferred fixed-port interpretation.

The source is an arbitrary causal joint data-memory CPTP process at the declared port. No common algebra/frame, low occupation gap, IID/reset source, low defect, or favorable noise promise is used for soundness. Fresh current roles, perturbations, candidates and keys must remain private from the pre-call source map; quantum response through that fixed map is allowed. Source access to unprocessed/returned payload registers, references, retired keys or decoder trash is excluded. Controls, storage, fixed clock and SPAM remain trusted or separately quantitatively budgeted.

The conclusion concerns the ACCEPTED subnormalized quantum instrument. The source may always force rejection. No quantum-capacity or practical-cost advantage is claimed. The conventional adaptive full-path alternative remains a serious comparator.

## 1. Two-role finite operation, with actual data-only acceptance
Fix p+s=1 with p>0,s>0, finite call cap T, and target J services. Every active round runs the always-output fixed-budget candidate solver BEFORE the private role. It records its actual rational candidate gap e_it, using a sound lower bound never below the trivial coefficient-l1 bound. Neutral preflight caps are ordered as in the reviewed schedule; a preflight resource abort rejects.

- LEARN, probability p: use the genuine product-Pauli input/readout bank. Update each35-coefficient feedback vector g_it and the shared probe counter. The unknown payload is not used in this call.
- SERVICE, probability s: process

# Receiving review: acquisition-only accepted operation

2026-10-29. Accepted at all-input subnormalized-instrument mathematics and exact counter-interface scope. This is a new accepted instrument, not reuse of a diagnostic under unproved postselection.

## Filtration and retrospective loss bound

The proof must refine the actual process by virtual good/bad CP labels after the fresh permutation or Pauli key has been averaged and retired. Those labels may change the conditional memory state. They cannot be identified with an observed error record, and the fine conditional losses need not equal coarse-history losses. Conditioning on retired keys would generally destroy the decomposition and is excluded.

On the fine pre-call history, controller weights are predictable functions of its coarser actual record. Fresh perturbations, role coins and the candidate-independent product-probe experiment remain independent of that past. Initial and evolving payload-memory correlations are retained. Local control on a stored slot does not alter the incoming memory marginal; fresh probe acquisition and the orbit bad effect see the same fine conditional marginal. The source itself must be fixed before current private choices, but may respond quantum mechanically to the supplied input.

The retrospective estimator offset has the correct sign: c=Iprobe*3/(4p)−sum(g)/2 and x=(phi+1)/2 yield the observable empirical score 3mNprobe/(4p)+sum G·phi/2. The martingale centers the learner's action loss before any retrospective candidate is introduced. The pathwise smoothed-potential bound is then at most the empirical score of ANY final data-selected candidate. Hence no hindsight comparator is inserted into unbiasedness or concentration. The same proof can be rerun on the fine filtration with exactly the observed counters, provided the trusted action/probe independence and neutral preflight schedule persist there. The separately received v2 theorem supports this use; it is not a claim about counterfactual source evolution.

The virtual fault increment is centered after revealing the current candidate but before the fresh role/key. Its conditional mean is bounded by s alpha times the current fine selected losses; conditional range is one. The two-stage filtration and tower property permit this martingale alongside the pre-candidate loss martingale. Stopping is padded only mathematicall

# Prequential acquisition-only certification for an arbitrary adaptive learner
2026-10-29. NEW load-bearing simplification; independent receiving review pending.

## Mechanism
The accepted acquisition-only protocol already chooses every current frame BEFORE its fresh private role and product-probe settings/outcomes. Evaluate the probe estimator at THAT current frame, rather than at a final retrospectively chosen frame. This elementary prequential order makes the existing learning bank an unbiased estimate of the actual selected loss. No FTPL regret, optimization-gap certificate or retrospective empirical minimization is needed for SOUNDNESS. A good learner still matters for yield. This is not a novel general statistical principle, not independent holdout, and not evaluation of a future frame using past records.

Retain the accepted service/outer-code/control interfaces and the fine filtration of acquisition_only_quantum_certificate_20261029/GOVERNING_v1.md. Use n even, m=n-1, alpha=2^n/Catalan(n/2); at the fixed four-spin port m=3,alpha=8 and cheap logical Pauli pads suffice. The learner may be any causal rule with finite execution and a valid current frame; fresh key/role privacy and pre-call process boundary remain required. Its current frame can depend on previous acquisition data, but not on the current role, probe settings or outcomes.

## Direct observed counter
For edge i at round t and its CURRENT rotation C_it, retain the actual native probe estimator

 d_hat_it(C_it)=3/4-(9/4)yz C_ab-(81/4)yzuv C_ab C_cd.

Here indices and signs are the actual product-probe/readout record in the inherited convention. Conditional on fine past and current candidate, its expectation is the actual fine-conditional star defect delta_it(C_it). Each entry of a rotation is in [-1,1], giving d_hat in [-87/4,93/4]. No IID/reset assumption is used.

Let I_t be the private LEARN indicator with probability p, and define

 W_t=I_t/p sum_i d_hat_it(C_it),
 D_t=sum_i delta_it(C_it)-W_t.

After current candidate selection but before current role/probe sampling, E[D_t|history,candidate]=0. W_t lies in [-87m/(4p),93m/(4p)], including its SERVICE value zero; hence the conditional range length of D_t is at most 45m/p. Hoeffding's conditional lemma, composed across the two-stage candidate/probe filtration, yields

 Pr[sum_t D_t > (45m/p)sqrt(T ln(1/delta_L)/2)] <= delta_L.
